d: Bangladesh refused to play in India and pulled out of the 2026 T20 World Cup. But now, 12 Bangladeshi cricketers have registered for the IPL auction. So, what changed? The political tensions between New Delhi and Dhaka remain, Sheikh Hasina is still a major flashpoint, and cricketing ties are yet to recover. But India's financial power is hard to ignore. From the IPL's massive revenues to the money other cricket boards make from hosting India, Palki Sharma examines why Bangladesh may be reconsidering its stand.
